master.prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. Game vehicle Basalt: mustard yellow heavy-haul prime mover with a multi-axle lowbed, carrying a rust-red ship hull block with weld seams secured with chains and appropriate cradles. Equipment: ladder to a high cab and huge mirrors; blank banners if any. Finish: heavy grime and chipped paint. Tires: 2.36 m off-road mud-terrain tires wrapped in heavy steel ladder chains (straight cross links). Exactly 4 near-side road wheels TOTAL for combined truck and lowbed, distribute axle positions between front cab at right and rear lowbed at left; all same size. Load stays attached as one illustration. Premium semi-realistic painted game illustration matching Swamp Scout, readable dark contours, fine mechanical details, rich weathered materials. strictly flat 2D side profile, camera perpendicular to the near side at hub height, no perspective, all tires the same size on one level line, no far-side tires. Facing RIGHT, cab front face invisible, only side visible. All wheels perfectly circular with centered rims and entirely visible; hub centers horizontal, tire bottoms level, chassis and load horizontal. Soft even daylight. Whole vehicle and load within frame with generous 100 pixel transparent margins on every side, no cropping. Wide canvas at least 1500 pixels long. True transparent background, no ground or cast shadow, no halo, no checkerboard, no text, logos or watermark. Exact layout: FOUR equal round road wheels, rear tandem at left and two at right. Wide clear margins, every antenna fully inside image.

True transparent background, no ground or shadow. Do not move or redesign anything.

Match rim color, bolt pattern, hub, grime, tread and chain style of master exactly. Square PNG canvas at least 1500x1500, perfectly circular tire centered with equal clear margins, hub exactly at canvas center. Face-on side elevation, soft even ambient light suitable for spinning.
